channel.title: The Multi-Rail Bank in 2026: Cards, A2A, Stablecoins, RTP, FedNow, and Open Banking in One Strategy
channel.description: FedNow demands pre-funded 24/7 liquidity. ACH is cheap but T+1. USDC clears atomically but needs wallet infrastructure. The 2026 multi-rail bank routes each payment by cost, finality, and liquidity cost — driven by an orchestration engine that reads ISO 20022 pacs.008 and decides.

item.title: The Multi-Rail Bank in 2026: Cards, A2A, Stablecoins, RTP, FedNow, and Open Banking in One Strategy
item.description: An engineering blueprint for the 2026 multi-rail bank — the routing matrix between FedNow, RTP, ACH, cards, and USDC; the 24/7 pre-funded liquidity trap; and the ISO 20022 pacs.008 bridge from legacy cores into A2A and Open Banking APIs.
